svg.title: PrismGate-Enterprise AWS architecture: animated request flow

g.text: Repeat prompt: PII scrubbed → cache HIT in DynamoDB → answered in <8 ms with $0 model cost
New, simple prompt: cache MISS → ML router → Amazon Nova Micro, ~99% cheaper than Claude
Complex prompt, streamed: cache MISS → ML router → Claude 3.5 Sonnet → answer streamed back over SSE
